description: Django models defining Course, Topic, Lesson, Student, and Progress entities for an educational planning application.

classes.name: Course
classes.description: A teacher-owned course that contains topics and lessons.

classes.name: Topic
classes.description: A topic that belongs to a course.

classes.name: Lesson
classes.description: A scheduled lesson for a given topic or directly under a course.

classes.name: Student
classes.description: A student record to track progress.

classes.name: Progress
classes.description: Progress tracking for a student against a topic, optionally tied to a lesson.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of Course, Topic, Lesson, Student, or Progress instances.
